definition: Babelfy is a software algorithm for the disambiguation of text written in any language.
details: It performs the tasks of multilingual Word Sense Disambiguation (i.e., the disambiguation of common nouns, verbs, adjectives and adverbs) and Entity Linking (i.e. the disambiguation of mentions to encyclopedic entities like people, companies, places, etc.).
story: Think of a grammar teacher who never memorized a rule but can still tell you when a sentence sounds wrong. Boil it down and it is this: Babelfy is a software algorithm for the disambiguation of text written in any language. Here is why it matters: It performs the tasks of multilingual Word Sense Disambiguation (i.e., the disambiguation of common nouns, verbs, adjectives and adverbs) and Entity Linking (i.e. the disambiguation of mentions to encyclopedic entities like people, companies, places, etc.). The machine learns to read between the lines by reading an impossible number of lines. That pattern-earned fluency is Babelfy.
